summary: Plan and review vocational programmes using occupational standards, learner evidence and practical management tools. Explore the course outline.
lede: TVET management training helps vocational education leaders and programme teams plan provision and link occupational standards to learner outcomes. Participants practise mapping standards to assessment evidence, analysing tracer-study findings and creating programme review plans and performance dashboards, while considering workshop capacity and learner progression records.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who plan, deliver, assess or oversee technical and vocational education, and need to connect programme decisions with occupational standards, learner evidence and resource constraints.
prerequisites: Recommended: experience in TVET delivery, administration or programme coordination. No coding is required; exercises use programme records, planning artefacts and spreadsheet-based indicators. Advanced digital management information systems are introduced at overview level, not implementation level.
